repo_info: axi_uart_periph 是一个基于 AXI4-Lite 可配置的 UART 外设，提供发送、接收、可编程波特率、TX/RX FIFO、状态寄存器与中断，面向 SoC 低速串口通信与调试场景。

data_flow.transformation: Shared typedefs, CSR field definitions, parity enums, and baud rate constants are imported into axi_lite_regs for register map compilation.
Python reference model reads baud rate constants and parity encoding enums to generate golden UART behavior matching RTL semantics.
Register module exposes AXI-Lite slave interface, CSR read/write data paths, and interrupt status flags for top-level integration.
Baud generator provides divided clock ticks and oversampling enable signals for UART TX/RX timing control at top level.
Sync FIFO exposes write-side data input, write enable, and full/empty status for uart_rx to buffer incoming bytes.
Sync FIFO exposes read-side data output, read enable, and empty/full status for uart_tx to fetch bytes for serialization.
RX module outputs decoded parallel byte data, framing error flags, and FIFO write control signals for top-level exposure.
TX module provides serialized UART output, transmitter busy/ready status, and FIFO read control for top-level integration.
Testbench instantiates DUT and drives AXI-Lite transactions while observing UART TX/RX pins to validate integrated peripheral behavior.
Lint script parses all RTL source files including top-level to enforce SystemVerilog coding standards and detect synthesis issues.
Simulation script compiles complete RTL hierarchy and links with testbench to execute functional verification with waveform dump.
Python reference model is invoked during simulation to compare DUT UART byte sequences against golden expected behavior.
Makefile defines lint target that invokes lint.sh script as the first validation step before simulation or synthesis flows.
Makefile defines sim target that invokes run_sim.sh script to compile and execute the complete testbench with DUT.
